rationale: P identifies ego-vehicle braking behaviour, specifically whether unintended braking occurs, which must be characterised to evaluate T and safety goal SG-3. Its operational scope is directly supported by hazard H-3. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of evaluation, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing requirements.
determining_elements: “Braking behaviour of the ego vehicle” identifies the system behaviour directly required by T.
“Whether braking occurs unintentionally” corresponds to SG-3 and H-3’s hazardous event of suddenly stopping despite no obstacle ahead.
The absence of visible obstacles or vehicles ahead and the straight-ahead, less-frequented urban-road setting at 50 km/h in good weather reproduce H-3’s operational situation.
No supporting observation or control mechanisms, or their timing constraints, are incorporated into P.
